title: ERP Procure-to-Pay, GR/IR Clearing & Tariff Cost Engine Configuration

org_configured.description: True once ERP Procure-to-Pay, GR/IR Clearing & Tariff Cost Engine organization thresholds and connectors are configured.

organization_name.description: Tenant legal entity or department name.

sheet_map.description: Optional mapping from canonical table key (e.g. invoices) to customer worksheet tab name.

column_map.description: Optional mapping from customer column header or connector JSON field name to canonical engine field name.

gr_ir_aging_threshold_days.description: Aging threshold in days for open GR/IR write-off review.

clearing_tolerance_usd.description: Residual value tolerance for automated MR11/F.13 clearing proposals.

annual_cost_of_capital_pct.description: Annual working-capital discount rate for payment terms modeling.

defect_cost_per_unit_usd.description: Estimated cost of poor quality per defective unit.

ppv_alert_threshold_pct.description: BOM component purchase price variance alert threshold %.
